title: Current state separate from dated history
summary: Current active rules remain applicable even when a newer topic gets attention.
body:
Current active rules remain applicable even when a newer topic gets attention.

Explicit supersedes links replace a decision; a timestamp alone does not.

Record meaningful decisions, feedback and outcomes before dependent work; not every conversational sentence.

Routine event logs remain separate from compact current records. Local logs survive local sessions but are not automatically in a Git clone.
